scope: Theorem 7.24 (One finite alternative for a countable kernel vector) of the manuscript “The critical Liouville quantum sphere and geometric limits of FK maps at q=4” (preprints/The-critical-Liouville-quantum-sphere-and-geometric-limits-of-FK-maps-at-q-equals-4-September-24-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 211 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 9b9236021eab20eb), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 134. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let A be any countable family of common cost extractions and fixed unit conversions. Conditional on the local real fields (including their heights), the local auxiliary field, and the private source pools, the vector of full-input conditional profile laws (Kα)α∈A has finite support. Equivalently, one tag T with finite conditional support almost surely suffices to write every coordinate as Kα = Fα(L, T), where L denotes these common local data. The tag is common to all coordinates; its number of possible values may depend on L.
